criticalCautions: Old central Night City is a peninsula with an eastern land connection, not an isolated island.
Wide San Morro Bay is explicitly shown; no southern cross-bay road bridge is shown in this 2020 overview.
The northern US 16 bridge is already present; a claim that 2020 has no bridges would be false.
Modern 2077 Heywood, Japantown, North Oak, Pacifica and Charter Hill names must not imply identical historic district footprints.

External freeway is marked California1 on Draken and101 on previous fan reference. Primary Sourcebook p14 instead shows US928 as an inland route and828toI5; neither fan number is proven, and external Draken line must not automatically become928.
California shields and numbered location tags are fan map presentation, not exact sourcebook addresses.
Draken collapses the detailed central district list; Little Italy, Upper Eastside, Old Downtown and New Harbor Area need Sourcebook plans rather than silently deleting them.
Region polygons are selection masks, not administrative boundaries. Label anchors do not define district extents.
Geometry describes the 2020 illustration; it does not prove a particular post-2023 reclamation project connecting it to the 2077 model.

primaryFreewayTopology.registrationPolicy: Use this primary topology as road naming authority. Draken coastal trace is for visual geometry; uncertain external freeway correspondence needs explicit registration, not casual renaming.

primaryChecks.finding: NightCityAreaFreeways primary regional map confirms DelCoronadoBridge,16Loop,828,126,928 andinterchanges; fan freeway numbers1/101 are not established by this primary map.
History describes Richard Night dredging Del Coronado Bay and using dredged material to fill old Morro Bay to create Old Downtown land; confirms engineered coast existed before 2020.
Ferry Building / Night City Ferry Corp diagram and timetables; ferry transport is canonical and useful where there are no road crossings.
